_comment: Ready-made option sets (same ids as gameplay_menu.json). Pass the "options" block to apply --options.

vanilla.description: No change: the ROM is left byte-identical.

quick_combat.description: Short waits between swings, quick charge, ordinary enemies only flinch from magic and critical hits.

arcade.description: No weapon wait, instant-ish charge, heroes shrug off small hits, triple criticals, brisk walking.

test_all.description: Stress set used by the emulator experiments.
